md: - Gold dissolves in **aqua regia** ('royal water', 3 conc HCl : 1 HNO3), not in nitric acid alone – asked with acid rain.
- 9. Fuse is in **series**; **low melting point**, high resistivity; ⚠ APPSC key (2012) gave low resistivity.
- **IndIGO** (Indian Initiative in Gravitational-wave Observations): consortium of Indian institutes behind LIGO-India; ⚠ APPSC key (2017) gave IndLIGO.
- **Measles in infants:** maternal antibodies (natural **passive** immunity) protect under ~6 months; MR vaccine at 9-12 and 16-24 months.

- **Hard water:** Ca/Mg salts form scum with soap; bicarbonates = **temporary** (boiling, Clark's lime); chlorides/sulphates = **permanent** (washing soda, ion exchange, Calgon).
- **Alloys:** brass = Cu + **Zn**; bronze = Cu + **Sn**; German silver Cu-Zn-Ni; solder Sn-Pb; **Dow metal = Mg + Al**; boiler superheater tubes = **Cr-Mo** steel.
- **Metals:** **tungsten** bulb filament (highest melting point); nichrome heater coil; **aluminium** most used in pure form (foil, cables), iron mostly as steel; sodium kept in **kerosene**.
- **Gold:** 24 carat pure; 22 carat = **91.6%** (916 hallmark, ~8.4% Cu/Ag); 18 carat = 75%; dissolves in **aqua regia** (3 HCl : 1 HNO3).
- **Materials:** **PVC** blood bags and dialysis tubes; **glass wool** = fine glass fibres (heat/sound insulation); **flint (lead) glass** lenses, prisms; Pyrex labware.
- **Others:** **CO2** extinguisher suits electrical fires; ruby = Al2O3 + **chromium**; Statue of Liberty green = copper **patina**; alkanes burn to CO2 + water + heat (⚠ APPSC key 2017 gave carbon).
- **Colloids:** blood and milk are colloids; milk = emulsion of **fat in water** (butter = water in fat); ⚠ APPSC key (2002) gave water dispersed in fat.

# Everyday Physics and Chemistry Basics
- **Units:** henry = inductance; farad = capacitance; pascal = pressure; decibel = sound level; angstrom = 10^-10 m; light year = distance; picosecond = 10^-12 s.
- **Instruments:** **lactometer** = milk purity (specific gravity); **hygrometer** = humidity; barometer = pressure; anemometer = wind speed; **atomic (caesium) clock** = most exact time.
- **Optics:** silvery crack in glass, diamond sparkle = **total internal reflection**; rainbow = refraction + dispersion + TIR; sky **black** in space (no scattering); convex mirror magnification <1.
- **Radiation:** **infrared** heat therapy for muscular pain; **X-rays** strongly darken photographic plates; fan under AC lamp seems to reverse (**stroboscopic** effect).
- **Mechanics:** mass measures **inertia**; friction opposes motion; doubling momentum makes KE x4 (**+300%**); no external force = centre-of-mass velocity **constant**; egg floats in denser salt water.
- **Electricity:** transformer works only on **AC**; bird on a live wire is safe (no **potential difference**); unmagnetised iron is attracted by **either** pole.
- **Heat:** tea cools fastest in a **metal** cup (good conductor); **free expansion** = into vacuum, no work, ideal-gas temperature unchanged.
- **Matter:** **plasma** (ionised gas) = 4th state, BEC = 5th; **liquid crystals** lie between solid and liquid, used in **LCD**.
- **Air:** inhaled ~**21% O2**, 78% N2, 0.04% CO2; exhaled ~16% O2, 4% CO2.
- **Chemistry basics:** **OIL RIG** (oxidation = electron loss); hydrogen = 'inflammable air' (**Cavendish 1766**), atomic number 1; **silicon** = 2nd most abundant crustal element after oxygen.
- **Molecules:** chiral = Greek 'hand'; **alkaloids** contain nitrogen; excess Li makes LiCl **pink** (F-centres); energy-absorbing reactions = **endergonic**, energy-releasing = exergonic.
